title: Quadernion
description:
• In all game modes you have to slide through the labyrinth with your cube.

• in Classic Mode: Collect all the items you can reach and don't lose any lives.

• in Time Mode: Collect all reachable items as quickly as possible.

• in Runes Mode: Collect all accessible objects and, if necessary, use the appropriate rune to slide through the rune gates.

• Currently 80 Labyrinth-Maps

• 3 different kind of Traps

• Player Customizing

• Day and Night-Cycle (Real Time, related on Map or permanently chosen Daytime)

• Levelsystem

• Achievements

• more Labyrinth-Maps

• more Traps

• more Gamemodes

• more Languages
description_short: Quadernion is a skill game about collecting items on multiple maze maps to overcome obstacles so you can collect more items or even go through the opened portal to complete the maze maps.
